connector.name: Dynatrace Managed MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Dynatrace Managed to access logs, events, and metrics.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dynatrace-managed-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dynatrace-oss account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_CALLS
env.description: Maximum number of tool calls allowed per rate limit window. Defaults to 20.

env.name: DT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
env.description: Rate limit window size in milliseconds. Defaults to 20000 (20 seconds).

env.name: DT_ENVIRONMENT_CONFIGS
env.description: An escaped JSON array that defines the Dynatrace Managed environment(s) to connect to. See README file for contents of this.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging level (e.g. debug, info, warning, error)
